grades.quote: Because programs frequently access the same locations again (that is, exhibit _temporal locality_ ) or access nearby locations (that is, exhibit _spatial locality_ ), the processor will often be able to get its data from the cache rather than from the slower main memory.
grades.reason: Explains how spatial locality affects cache performance, a possible contributor to slow page-strided array access, but does not address page-sized strides specifically.
Discusses disk request locality and scheduling, not array accesses in memory.
Discusses concurrent linked-list races and locking, not memory-stride performance.
